description: Test a change without resetting the competing rating. hold keeps the revision that competes while later saves become a testing revision that plays only in practice; promote makes the tested revision (pass revisionId) compete, from a fresh rating; release ends the hold, so the latest save competes; discard saves the competing source back as the latest. Ask the player first. robots with view "project" shows the staging state.

operationId.description: Identifies this operation for retries. Leave it out for a fresh one; pass the one a pending result gave to finish it.

revisionId.description: promote or discard: the revision you tested

name: stage_robot
